newsitem.title: ITALY: February CPI data of 11 Italian cities revised.
newsitem.headline: February CPI data of 11 Italian cities revised.

text.p: February consumer prices from 11 sample Italian cities have been revised to take account of an Italian administrative court decision in February to suspend electricity tariff reductions.
The court, which made its decision on the same day as preliminary February data was released, suspended the tariff cuts which had been introduced on February 13.
Seven of the 11 cities publish their March preliminary consumer prices after 1630 GMT on Thursday, while four more release theirs on Friday.

Following are the final February prices for all 11 cities according to national statistics institute Istat. Data in brackets indicate the inflation rates originally given on February 20/21 which do not include the price cut suspension.
Final CPI for February, released by Istat on March 4, showed a rate of 2.4 percent year-on-year and 0.1 percent month on month.
